name: Fact Extraction
description: Extracts discrete, verifiable factual claims from content
system_prompt: You are a fact extraction specialist. Extract discrete, verifiable factual claims from the provided content. Each fact should be a single, specific, falsifiable statement. Categorize each fact appropriately. Do NOT extract opinions, speculation, or vague generalizations.

output.schema_for_llm: [{"claim": "The full factual claim as stated", "simplified_claim": "A shorter version (max 100 chars)", "category": "historical|scientific|statistical|biographical|geographical|political|economic|cultural|legal|medical|technological|other", "confidence_score": 0.0-1.0, "source_citation": "Citation if mentioned in text"}]
